summary: Adds read-only GET /api/version to src/afaw_web/app.py. It returns release_tag and commit_sha from AFAW_RELEASE_TAG and AFAW_COMMIT_SHA, and an unset or empty variable gives the string unknown. It makes no network call and reads no file. POST returns 405 and the OpenAPI entry has a one-line summary. Five tests were written first in tests/web/test_version.py and red_check confirmed all five fail on the old code.
next: Human: set AFAW_RELEASE_TAG and AFAW_COMMIT_SHA at deploy time (needs .gitlab-ci.yml and deploy/, which are human-only files)
